response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), with_freq AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, avg_amount, AVG(avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS freq_avg FROM per_account) SELECT account_id, frequency, avg_amount, CASE WHEN freq_avg = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_amount * 1.0 / freq_avg END AS ratio FROM with_freq ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The stored unsigned amount is averaged as-is across all transaction types (PRIJEM, VYDAJ, VYBER), as the request specifies, with no sign adjustment.
The frequency average is the unweighted mean of per-account averages (each account counts equally), as requested.
Ratio is NULL when the frequency average is 0 (to avoid division by zero); NULLs sort last.
Ties in ratio are ordered arbitrarily since no tie-breaker was specified.
